title: WorldPacks
description: This plugin allows you to install resource packs on individual worlds
body:
WorldPacks is a plugin that allows you to install resource packs for each world separately.
This plugin is more suitable for testing or powerful servers.

 The plugin does not track resource packs by sha1, eliminates errors that may occur in other plugins.

 It also provides logging in the console, allowing you to understand where the issue lies in the source or the client using the resource pack.
 
unique global-pack mechanics with convenient world transitions.

Config detailed explanation:

global-pack - The resource pack that is responsible for all the worlds in the (global-worlds) tab

global-world - list of combined worlds that are affected by (global-pack)

worlds - other worlds that are not affected by (global-pack)

 commands:
 
 /wp reload - reloading the plugin configuration

 permissions:

 only operator -- no permissions

#  what is this plugin for?


 **This plugin is suitable for large-scale servers with different game modes to improve the visual perception of the game mode. for example
for the murder-mystery mode, the bow can be replaced with a revolver for the sheriff.
 for the bedwars mode, you can optimize the blocks and reduce the tools for beauty
 etc.**
